panels.ocrText:
Retatrutide (Reta)
Triple hormone activator. Lowers hunger hard
and increases energy burn. Stronger than
semaglutide for fat loss.
Dose used in studies: 2-12 mg weekly
(titrated slowly).
Fat loss often visible in 4-8 weeks.
Side effects: nausea, vomiting, low appetite,
fatigue. Still in clinical trials.
panels.scene: Black background text panel about Retatrutide weight loss drug

panels.ocrText:
Tesamorelin
Strong growth hormone releaser. Often used
to reduce deep belly fat.
Typical dose: 2 mg daily, often at night.
Visible belly fat changes in 4-8 weeks.
Can cause water retention and joint tightness.
panels.scene: Text-only panel describing Tesamorelin for belly fat reduction

panels.ocrText:
GHK-Cu
Improves skin quality and healing. Boosts
collagen for firmer skin.
Typical dose: 1-2 mg daily (injection or topical
use).
Skin changes usually seen in 4-8 weeks.
Rare skin irritation if topical.
panels.scene: Text-only panel detailing GHK-Cu skincare benefits and usage.

panels.ocrText:
TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4)
Helps repair tissue and improve blood flow to
injured areas. Used for bigger injuries.
Typical dose: 2-5 mg per week, split into 2
shots, for 4-6 weeks.
Results usually show in 2-4 weeks.
Possible fatigue or mild headache.
panels.scene: Black background text panel about TB-500

panels.ocrText:
BPC-157
Speeds up healing in tendons, ligaments,
 muscle, and gut lining. Popular for stubborn
 injuries.
 Typical dose: 250-500 mcg daily (split
 morning and night).
 Most notice less pain in 1-3 weeks.
 Side effects are rare, sometimes mild nausea
 or headache.
panels.scene: Black background text panel about BPC-157 healing properties

panels.ocrText:
CJC-1295 (no DAC) + Ipamorelin
Signals your body to release more growth
hormone. Helps with muscle growth, fat loss,
recovery, and sleep.
Typical dose: 100–200 mcg of each, 1–3 times
daily. Often before bed.
Sleep improves in 1–2 weeks. Body changes in
6–12 weeks.
Possible water retention, tingling hands, mild
hunger.
panels.scene: Text panel detailing CJC-1295 and Ipamorelin stack benefits

panels.ocrText:
IGF-1 LR3
Insulin-like Growth Factor. Directly tells
muscle cells to grow. Much stronger than GH
alone.
Common dose: 20-50 mcg daily (short cycles
4-6 weeks).
Muscle fullness felt in 1-2 weeks.
Risks: low blood sugar, organ growth if
abused.

WHAT PEPTIDES ACTUALLY ARE
(and why they're not as complicated as they sound)

Peptides are short chains of amino acids 🧬
They already exist naturally in your body.

Their job is cell communication.
They help your cells recognize signals like:
• repair
• balance
• recovery
• metabolism

Think of peptides as tiny messengers that
tell your body where and how to respond
instead of forcing change.

That's why they tend to feel supportive, not extreme.
panels.scene: gym background with text overlay about peptides

panels.ocrText:
HOW PEPTIDES WORK IN THE BODY
Peptides don't override your system.
They plug into pathways your body already uses.

They help:
• speed up healing signals
• improve efficiency
• reduce "miscommunication" caused by
stress, hormones, or aging

This is why the right peptide can feel subtle
but powerful ✨

WHAT PEPTIDES ACTUALLY ARE

Peptides are short chains of amino acids 🧬

Their job is cell communication.
They help your cells recognize signals like:
• repair
• balance
• recovery
• metabolism

Think of peptides as tiny messengers that
tell your body where and how to respond
instead of forcing change.

That's why they tend to feel supportive, not extreme.
